title: The Italian Renaissance
subtitle: Commerce, patronage and classical learning
rightsNote: Original educational text; accompanying audio is synthetic demo audio, NOT a VOA recording.

lines.english: The Renaissance did not begin with a single event or a single brilliant artist.
lines.chinese: 文艺复兴并非始于某个单一事件或某位天才艺术家。

lines.english: It developed gradually in a network of Italian cities, including Florence and Venice.
lines.chinese: 它逐渐发展于包括佛罗伦萨和威尼斯在内的意大利城市网络之中。

lines.english: Trade and finance helped some merchant families accumulate substantial wealth.
lines.chinese: 贸易和金融帮助一些商人家族积累了可观的财富。

lines.english: These families supported painters, architects and scholars through patronage.
lines.chinese: 这些家族通过赞助支持画家、建筑师和学者。

lines.english: Patronage created opportunities, but it also shaped which projects received attention.
lines.chinese: 赞助创造了机会，但也影响了哪些项目能够获得关注。

lines.english: Competition between city-states encouraged rulers to display their prestige through art.
lines.chinese: 城邦之间的竞争促使统治者通过艺术展示自身声望。

lines.english: At the same time, humanist scholars studied ancient Greek and Roman writing with renewed interest.
lines.chinese: 与此同时，人文主义学者以新的热情研究古希腊和古罗马著作。

lines.english: The Renaissance emerged from the interaction of economic, political and intellectual forces.
lines.chinese: 文艺复兴源于经济、政治和思想力量之间的相互作用。
